title: Pro Diamond Rolling Knife Sharpener 5 Adjustable Angles Magnetic Base Hone Tool
body_html:
Description:
- This professional diamond knife sharpener set is an ideal complement for any kitchen or workshop, designed specifically for precise knife sharpening and tool maintenance.
- By manual operation, it can perform efficient grinding without the need for electricity or batteries.
- The set includes a durable wooden base and diamond grinding discs, providing a long-lasting grinding solution.
- 5 Five Perspectives:: Offers 12°, 15°, 17°, 19°, and 22° angles, catering to those who require more precise and versatile sharpening for a variety of tools.
- Each base features a tumbler rolling knife sharpening function, ensuring a consistent and accurate sharpening angle every time.
- Whether you're a chef, DIY enthusiast, or outdoor adventurer, this Diamond Sharpener Set is a must-have tool to keep your blades sharp and ready for action.



Feature:
- Precise and long-lasting sharpness: Any serious chef knows that high-quality knives are expensive. The roller knife sharpener allows you to maintain cutting performance like new for a longer period. You can obtain factory-sharp knives in just a few minutes.
- Diamond drive: The grinding disc is coated with the hardest and most effective sharpening stone in nature: diamond. The 400-grit blades can easily remove the first layer of the blade edge while restoring sharpness.
- Finer edges: The proprietary ceramic honing disc at the other end of the kitchen sharpening kit can remove burrs from the blade edge after sharpening.
- Simple but effective: The roller knife sharpening kit may seem simple, but its functionality is astonishing. Just select your angle and use the magnetic knife holder to fix your blade. Then, roll the disc back and forth until it becomes sharp. Finally, flip the sharpening kit and use the ceramic disc to polish the edge.


Package Include:
1 Set Sharpening Tool
